test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 30 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Refer to the given series and answer the question that follows (all numbers are single-digit numbers only, and all counting is to be done from left to right).

(Left) 3 5 5 7 1 6 1 8 8 7 6 2 2 5 9 8 1 1 5 3 3 2 8 1 7 9 2 (Right)

How many such even digits are there each of which is immediately preceded by a perfect square and immediately followed by an odd digit? (Note: 1 will be considered as a perfect square.)
solution:
Given series:

(Left) 3 5 5 7 1 6 1 8 8 7 6 2 2 5 9 8 1 1 5 3 3 2 8 1 7 9 2 (Right)

According to the question, such even digits which are immediately preceded by perfect square and also immediately followed by an odd digit:

Required condition: perfect square - Even - odd 

(Left) 3 5 5 7 **__1 6 1__** 8 8 7 6 2 2 5**__ 9 8 1__** 1 5 3 3 2 8 1 7 9 2 (Right)

Thus, there are 2 such even digits which are immediately preceded by a perfect square and also immediately followed by an odd digit

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
